afterFileEdit.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v chainloop >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec chainloop trace hook cursor after-file-edit'

postToolUse.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v chainloop >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec chainloop trace hook cursor post-tool-use'

preToolUse.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v chainloop >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "{\"permission\":\"allow\"}"; exit 0; fi; exec chainloop trace hook cursor pre-tool-use'

sessionEnd.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v chainloop >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec chainloop trace hook cursor session-end'

sessionStart.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v chainloop >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec chainloop trace hook cursor session-start'
